correctness.rationale: All essential inferences and computations in the fallback-scope claim were independently verified by code review and reruns; proof is correctly distinguished from computed evidence. (1) Symmetry freeze: reran inputs/artifacts/symmetry_lemma.py — group size 8, 7 single-pattern orbits (sizes 2,4,2,8,4,2,2), 300 unordered pairs with repetition falling into 63 orbits (56 distinct), canon A=((0,1,2,3),(0,2,3,1)) vs canon B=((0,2,1,3),(0,3,2,1)) distinct, extremal lemma verified over all 24 rank tuples. Audit additionally confirmed B's orbit contains Av(1324,3214)-type, so 'symmetric to Av(1324,3214)' is correct. (2) P1 generating-tree DFS (p1_dfs.py) reviewed line-by-line: hereditary argument is sound (deleting last entry and renormalizing an avoider yields an avoider; every avoider has exactly one parent), renormalization q=[x+1 if x>=v else x]+[v] enumerates all k+1 children, incremental check of only C(k,3) quads using new last position is sufficient because any forbidden quad not using it was already excluded. Lemma implementation (a==min/max via strict inequalities plus b<c and (c<d or d<b)) exactly encodes (b<c<d or d<b<c) since both disjuncts imply b<c. Reruns: P1 A9=[1,1,2,6,22,89,380,1678,7584,34875] checksum 0c51d08a18ff47d0 and B9=[1,1,2,6,22,89,380,1677,7566,34676] checksum 338b870954cfeb1f (match draft); P1 A10=162560 checksum 21cf06f7eeb08e18 and B10=160808 checksum 5a2d4f99df6e169c (match); P1 A11=766124/B11=752608 and A12=3644066/B12=3548325 (match draft §5). Boundary n=4=22=24-2 correct; agreement to n=6 and first separation n=7 by 1 confirmed. (3) P2 direct checker (p2_direct.py) uses independent sorting-based rank tuple pat4 and flat itertools.permutations with C(n,4) scan, trivial n<4 factorial, no shared code with P1. Reruns: P2 A8=7584/B8=7566 match P1; independent B9 direct recount gave 34676 in ~10.6s, matching P1. (4) Census third path (census_56.py, comparison-count rankcode packed as r0+4*r1+16*r2+64*r3) rerun to n=9 gave 38 distinct sequences, block sizes [10,5,4,2,2,1x33], largest Schroder block 1,2,6,22,90,394,1806,8558,41586, A/B singleton TARGET blocks matching draft; inspected inputs/artifacts/census_56.json N=10 gives same 38 blocks with largest extended to 206098. (5) Presentation honesty: DRAFT §5 labels separating vector as 'computed evidence', §7 explicitly defers DFA/rationality/n=14, labels n=11..13 'single-program (P1)' and census 'candidate-equivalence only, may split', §5.3 records failed live OEIS fetch as limitation. No overclaim of proof where only enumeration exists. No computation error found in verified range.

originality.rationale: The claimed Wilf-distinctness theorem is prior art, conceded by the draft itself, and no new mathematical object, classification, formula, or automaton is delivered. Nearest priors (from topic.json, treated as untrusted pointers but corroborated by draft admissions and internal consistency): (a) Le (2005) 'Wilf Classes of Pairs of Permutations of Length 4' DOI 10.37236/1922 proves the complete Wilf-classification of (4,4) pairs via block bijections — draft §1 states 'The Wilf-distinctness theorem itself is due to Le (2005); our contribution is only the machine-checkable certificate' and 'We add no new classification theorem'. Hence A vs B separation (agree to n=6, differ 1678 vs 1677 at n=7) is not new. (b) OEIS A165543 (A, algebraic) and A165542 (B, NOFORMULA): draft reproduces assignment-quoted values to n=9 exactly plus B10=160808 note; topic states b-files to 270+ terms, so vectors to n=10 and P1 extensions to n=13 (17469863 vs 16830544) add no new sequence terms beyond OEIS — mere recomputation. (c) Kremer-Shiu (2003) finite transfer matrices for many (4,4) pairs: draft states 'We do not reproduce their matrices; our trie is an unminimized generating tree.' (d) Albert-Linton-Ruskuc insertion-encoding regularity criterion: draft states 'We do not instantiate a minimized DFA for B here' and §7 records regularity_probe.py as inconclusive with correct analysis not completed. The target's novel component (minimized DFA <500 states or Kremer-type transfer matrix plus counts to n=14 resolving rationality of A165542) is explicitly NOT done. (e) 56-type census (38 sequences, largest size-10 Schroder block 1,2,6,22,90,394,1806,8558,41586,206098) is strictly weaker than Le's true classification — draft §6 admits 'No Wilf-equivalence is proved beyond n=10; blocks are candidate-equivalence (necessary but not sufficient)'. Schroder block is textbook separable-permutation enumeration. New artifacts are only scripts/checksums/runtimes, not a new gap, bijection, GF, or DFA. A timestamp or failed search does not establish priority; here priority lies with cited prior art that predates the candidate.

value.rationale: Even taking correctness as given, the fallback-scope result is not independently worth finding later; it falls squarely into SCOPE reject categories. (1) Mere verification: two-program recomputation of OEIS A165542/A165543 to n=10 where OEIS already carries 270+ terms and Le already proves distinctness is textbook checking, not a finding a later researcher would search for and cite. (2) Unexplained enumeration: 38 candidate blocks to n=10 without bijections, GFs, or growth results (draft admits they 'may split at n=11+; we assert only the computed table'), and brute-force terms to n=13 (single-program for n>=11) with no generating function, bijection, growth-rate theorem, or rationality resolution. (3) Tiny unmotivated gain: extending single-program brute-force counts from n=10 (162560/160808) to n=13 where closed-form status is unchanged (A algebraic, B still NOFORMULA/unresolved) and OEIS already extends further. (4) Textbook restatement: hereditary generating-tree correctness argument is standard enumerative-combinatorics method. (5) The valuable part of the target — minimized insertion-encoding DFA/transfer-matrix files yielding independent counts to n=14 and regularity/rationality datum for NOFORMULA class B — is explicitly deferred (§7: 'No minimized DFA, no rational GF, no transfer matrix, no counts to n=14'). The fallback 'OEIS-audit and Le-verification note' (topic fallback_claim) does not clear the bar: honest limitations (§7-§9) confirm no proof of growth rates, no bijection, no GF for B, no live b-file diff. Comparable SCOPE precedent rejects narrowly-new but uncitable enumerations; a fortiori a correct-but-known recomputation with no new terms or theory must be REJECT.
